item.title: Making Payment To Staff’s Personal Accounts Not Uncommon In MOH, Say Doctors
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
At least two govt doctors say they usually make payments to coworkers' personal accounts for work, like courses or department activities like parties. Receipts are given for course materials. Salary overpayment occurs, like RM14k over 3 years for one MO. The post Making Payment To Staff’s Personal Accounts Not Uncommon In MOH, Say Doctors appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: 300L RON95 Quota Isn’t A Privilege, But A Necessity For Public Health Assistants — KPKASM
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Public health assistants (PKA) are among the groups most affected by the reduction of the RON95 fuel subsidy quota from 300 to 200 litres because they conduct a substantial portion of their work in the field, moving between locations to do inspections.
